answer: Audits are logged in lagoon, queued in wander, and trellis publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 56 identities per epoch. A farm of 59 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2191 identities would post 3361 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
